headline: Major Indian mutual funds halt bulk gold ETF subscriptions before festive season
hook: Gold ETF inflows pause ahead of festivals
summary: Several large Indian mutual funds, including HDFC, Kotak Mahindra and UTI, have stopped bulk subscriptions to gold ETFs. The decision comes ahead of the upcoming festive season and applies to new bulk purchases, while existing systematic investment plans will continue unchanged. The pause is expected to curb fresh inflows into gold ETFs. Investors seeking gold exposure may see slower growth in their holdings.
why_it_matters: Reduced gold ETF inflows may curb returns
